files.description: The review rules for this repository: path-scoped instructions, pre-merge checks, and the standards documents they rely on. .greptile/rules.md says how to apply them.
How work is done here: the publication boundaries, commit rules, when a review is asked for, the crate and port layout, the routes, serde conventions and the test tiers.
Contribution rules: tests, changelog entries, documentation and pull request conventions.
Security policy: untrusted input, keys and secrets, and how vulnerabilities are handled.
The node's public description and its crate list.
Who decides what, and how decisions are recorded.
The index of this repository's documentation.
The crates, the ports they implement, and the boundaries between them.
What each part of the node is for.
The patterns this codebase uses and why.
Authentication and authorisation: API keys, roles, credentials and the auth middleware.
How passports and their records are stored and served.
The database, its migrations and the app role.
The event bus and the job store.
The evidence dossier: what it carries and how it is verified.
The GS1 resolver's conformance to the GS1 Digital Link resolver standard.
The standards register: every standard the code cites, its status and the evidence for each conformance claim.
Branches, pull requests and how changes land on main.
The release checklist and how images are published.
The versioning rules, and the CHANGELOG convention: every breaking change under a Breaking heading with a migration note.
Local development, the just recipes, the test tiers and the guard scripts.
How an operator configures and runs a node.
How the demo is run.
Webhooks: delivery, signing and target rules.
How long passport data is kept, and why.
Licensing of this repository and its dependencies.
Which metrics the node exposes, and what they are for.
How a production node is operated and recovered.
The project's intended shape.
The node's endpoints.
The one home for the app role's DELETE set and the grants that `just grants-check` gates against.
